verdict.rationale: Tailscale ships an official CLI with dedicated reference documentation (tailscale-probe-3), and it supports automation via infrastructure-as-code and webhooks (tailscale-docs-12), plus a tsnet package for embedding in programs (tailscale-docs-14), which fits scriptable/agentic workflows.
